front_line: Karooooo is quietly building the operating system for everything that moves.
thesis: Watchlist. The business is genuinely good and the crux is unusually monitorable, but at fair value with the whole thesis resting on an unproven cash inflection, there is no reason to pay full price for the unproven part today. What changes it: an October print showing FCF conversion climbing back toward 20%+ of operating cash while subscriber growth holds — that de-risks the base case and moves this toward Open.
moat: Real decade-durable switching-cost moat in South Africa, but narrow, geographically trapped, and its low-churn proxy weakened when FY2026 margins compressed.
risks: Capex grew ~34% annually (FY23–FY26) while operating cash barely moved; the scissors are widening, not narrowing.
